summary: Frontend-only verification of the Machines (Maschinen) crash bug fix in /app/frontend/app/machines/index.tsx. Seeded a corrupt machine with status='available' (the original crash trigger) plus a valid machine, then opened /machines/ via the Expo web preview. All 5 verification scenarios passed: (1) screen rendered without crash, (2) self-healing auto-rewrote the invalid status to 'verfuegbar' in AsyncStorage on load, (3) Kopier button created 'Test Bagger (Kopie)' with status='verfuegbar' and empty serial_number, (4) quick-toggle on the green status badge cycled verfuegbar -> einsatz (now showing 'Im Einsatz' blue badge) without crashing, (5) navigating away and re-opening Machines screen multiple times worked fine. The defensive `|| STATUS_OPTIONS[0]` fallback (line 616) and the validStatus normalization in load() (lines 187-198) both function correctly. No new React Native red-screen errors were thrown during testing.
action_items: Bug fix verified end-to-end on web preview. No further action needed for this crash. Main agent can ship to TestFlight.

OPTIONAL HARDENING (low priority): the same defensive `find(...) || OPTIONS[0]` pattern should be applied wherever STATUS/CONDITION/EQUIP options are looked up by raw stored values across other screens (Materials/Employees) if they share the same pattern of trusting persisted string enums. Not required for this fix.

Note: discrepancy in original problem-statement (mentions 'in_einsatz'/'in_wartung'/'defekt') vs actual MachineMaster type in LocalStorage.ts line 2154 ('einsatz'/'wartung'/'ausgeliehen'). The fix uses the actual values from the type, which is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: machines/index.tsx is now 1500+ lines — consider splitting modal/edit logic into a sub-component for maintainability (not blocking).
Self-healing in load() uses sequential awaits in a for-loop (lines 191-193). For users with many corrupt records this could be slow; Promise.all would be faster. Not a real issue at expected scale.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: handleDuplicate set status:'available' which is not in MachineMaster type ('verfuegbar'|'einsatz'|'wartung'|'ausgeliehen'|'nicht_verfuegbar'). STATUS_OPTIONS.find(s=>s.value===m.status||'verfuegbar') returned undefined (because 'available' is truthy so fallback never triggered), then `!` non-null assertion + property access (st.bg, st.icon) crashed the render permanently. Fix applied 3-fold: (a) corrected the duplicate's status to 'verfuegbar', (b) replaced `!` with `|| STATUS_OPTIONS[0]` defensive default (line 616), (c) auto-heal pass in load() rewrites any persisted invalid status to 'verfuegbar' on next launch, recovering already-corrupted user data without manual wipe. All three layers were verified working.
